metadata.title: Kondo & Asai (1995) Piecewise-Linear Saturating Gierer-Meinhardt Reaction-Diffusion Wave, Growing-Domain Mid-Trough Stripe Insertion (Pomacanthus semicirculatus) & 2D Y-Branch Unzipping (Pomacanthus imperator) Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Kondo S, Asai R (1995). A reaction-diffusion wave on the skin of the marine angelfish Pomacanthus. Nature 376(6543):765-768.
Gierer A, Meinhardt H (1972). A theory of biological pattern formation. Kybernetik 12(1):30-39.
Crampin EJ, Gaffney EA, Maini PK (1999). Reaction and diffusion on growing domains: scenarios for robust pattern formation. Bulletin of Mathematical Biology 61(6):1093-1120.
Kondo S, Iwashita M, Yamaguchi M (2009). How animals get their skin patterns: fish pigment pattern as a live Turing wave. International Journal of Developmental Biology 53(5-6):851-856.

pomacanthus_semicirculatus_juvenile_stri.species: Pomacanthus semicirculatus (Semicircle angelfish juvenile, Kasai Rinkai Park Aquarium, Tokyo, showing alternating primary white stripes and newly inserted secondary blue/white mid-trough stripes)
pomacanthus_semicirculatus_juvenile_stri.author: Totti / Wikimedia Commons

kondo_asai_1995_piecewise_linear_rd_syst.section: Kondo & Asai (1995) Nature 376(6543):765-768 Fig. 1 legend & Methods

governing_pde.activator_eq: dA/dt = F(A, I) - g_A * A + D_A * Lap(A),  where F(A, I) = min(F_max, max(0, c_1 * A + c_2 * I + c_3))
governing_pde.inhibitor_eq: dI/dt = G(A, I) - g_I * I + D_I * Lap(A_or_I),  where G(A, I) = min(G_max, max(0, c_4 * A + c_5))
governing_pde.growing_domain_law: L(t) = L_0 * exp(gamma * t)  (uniform isotropic/axial skin expansion with dilution/metric scaling D / L(t)^2)

pomacanthus_semicirculatus_insertion_cas.section: Kondo & Asai (1995) Nature 376:765-768 Figs. 1-2 (1D Mid-Trough New Stripe Insertion in P. semicirculatus)
pomacanthus_semicirculatus_insertion_cas.mechanism: As body length doubles (2 -> 4 -> 8 -> 16 cm), inter-stripe spacing stretches toward 2 * lambda_c; inhibitor I(x,t) falls below threshold at the midpoint between adjacent primary stripes, triggering de novo secondary activator peak insertion that restores wavelength lambda_c.

regimes.label: Subcritical Inhibitor Diffusion Control (D_I = 0.050, d = 7.14 < d_c = 10.26)
regimes.description: When D_I / D_A = 7.14 < d_c = 10.26, det M(k^2) > 0 for all k^2 >= 0; perturbations decay to homogeneous pigment state (A*, I*) = (3.0, 2.5).

regimes.label: Juvenile Stage s = 1 (Body Length 2.0 cm -> 3 Primary Stripes)
regimes.description: Juvenile P. semicirculatus (< 2 cm) exhibits 3 equidistant vertical white/blue stripes at intrinsic wavelength lambda_c = 3.474 units.

regimes.label: First Doubling Stage s = 2 (Body Length 4.0 cm -> 6 Stripes via 3 Mid-Trough Insertions)
regimes.description: At 4 cm body length, new thinner secondary stripes emerge in the middle of each inter-stripe trough, doubling total stripe count from 3 to 6.

regimes.label: Second Doubling Stage s = 4 (Body Length 8.0 cm -> 12 Stripes via 6 Mid-Trough Insertions)
regimes.description: As earlier secondary stripes widen to full intensity and body length reaches 8 cm, a second wave of mid-trough insertions yields 12 stripes.

regimes.label: Third Doubling Stage s = 8 (Body Length 16.0 cm -> 24 Stripes via 12 Mid-Trough Insertions)
regimes.description: At 16 cm body length, the third doubling stage stabilizes 24 periodic stripes while preserving homeostatic inter-stripe wavelength lambda_c.

pomacanthus_imperator_y_branch_unzipping.section: Kondo & Asai (1995) Nature 376:765-768 Figs. 3-4 (2D Y-Junction Branch Point Horizontal Unzipping in P. imperator)
pomacanthus_imperator_y_branch_unzipping.mechanism: In adult P. imperator horizontal stripes, dorso-ventral flank expansion widens interior inter-stripe spacing toward 2 * lambda_c while anterior/posterior boundary spacing remains fixed; a Y-shaped branch dislocation forms and migrates horizontally across the flank like a zipper, increasing stripe number from N to N + 1.
